name: LC Group Holding Limited
summary: LC Group Holding Limited, a freight forwarding company, provides integrated cross-border seaborne logistics and time charter services in Mainland China and internationally. The company offers cross-border logistics services, including cargo pick-up and sorting, customs clearance, cross-border seaborne transportation, warehouse transit, and last-mile delivery. It also offers vessel chartering; and e-commerce services, as well as involved in the leasing of its container vessels to third parties; and trading of imported goods. The company was formerly known as LC Logistics, Inc. and change its name to LC Group Holding Limited in July 2026. The company was founded in 2004 and is based in Qingdao…
